The existing message-750 MODIFY already moves the requirement to the integrated-board context. The charge LED is an external interface rather than an interboard connector, so its attributes remain valid.
Combining the boards does not change the requirement for effective heat transfer through the AXP2101 exposed-pad PCB design.
Battery protection remains required, but its POWER_BOARD scope context becomes obsolete when all circuitry moves to the integrated board.

decisions.reason: The source preserves functionality and does not change the AXP2101 as the normal power source, the battery voltage range, or coverage of all system loads.
The battery connector is an external interface rather than an interboard connector, and the source does not resolve or change its pin-order ambiguity.

The current activation condition depends on USB-C being connected without a separate power board, which is incompatible with the new integrated-board architecture, but the source does not determine the replacement source-selection or isolation behavior.
The existing Event correctly removes the interboard cable-length constraint and changes scope, but it leaves the pull-ups located on the obsolete separate main board rather than the integrated board.
